gaps.sentence: I did it ___ my own initiative — nobody asked me.
gaps.explanation: 'of one's own initiative' = without being asked.

gaps.sentence: The venue was changed at ___ notice, just two days before.
gaps.explanation: 'At short notice' = only a short time before.

gaps.sentence: Everything was left ___ the care of the next-door neighbours.
gaps.explanation: 'In the care of' = looked after by.'

gaps.sentence: The team is out of ___ after the long break.
gaps.explanation: 'Out of practice' = having lost skill through lack of use.

gaps.sentence: ___ comparison with last year, sales have doubled.
By all ___ , the festival was a triumph this year.
gaps.explanation: 'By all accounts' = according to what people say.

gaps.sentence: We spoke ___ the phone for an hour.
___ first, the plan sounded ridiculous — then it grew on us.
gaps.explanation: 'At first' = in the beginning (contrast with 'first' = before anything else).
